hero.name: Yash Musanwar
hero.intro: Passionate Frontend Developer skilled in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React.js, Tailwind CSS, and Bootstrap, with a strong focus on creating responsive, user-friendly, and visually appealing web applications. Adept at translating designs into clean, efficient code while ensuring seamless user experiences across devices.

about.heading: A little about me
paragraphs: I'm a Frontend Developer skilled in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React.js, Tailwind CSS, and Bootstrap, with a strong focus on creating responsive, user-friendly, and visually appealing web applications.

I enjoy translating designs into clean, efficient code while ensuring seamless user experiences across devices, and I'm continuously learning and exploring modern web technologies to build interactive, high-performance UIs.

items.title: Portfolio Website
items.description: A responsive and visually appealing portfolio website built using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Showcases projects, skills, and contact information with a modern, interactive UI, smooth animations, a dark/light mode toggle, and mobile-friendly design. Implements seamless navigation and form handling, optimized for performance and accessibility.

items.title: Weather Application
items.description: A responsive weather application built using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript that fetches real-time weather data from an API and displays temperature, humidity, wind speed, and conditions for any searched location. Features dynamic backgrounds based on weather conditions and error handling for invalid locations.

items.title: To-Do List
items.description: A simple, intuitive task management app built using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Allows users to add, edit, complete, and delete tasks with local storage integration, drag-and-drop reordering, and filter options for better task organization.
Completed a 6-month internship as a Web Developer Trainee in Nagpur, Maharashtra, building and maintaining responsive, user-facing web interfaces using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React.js, and Bootstrap.
responsibilities: Collaborated with the development team to translate design requirements into clean, functional, cross-browser compatible web pages, styled using Bootstrap and Tailwind CSS
Assisted in debugging and optimizing existing codebases, improving UI performance and overall user experience across multiple client-facing pages
Practiced professional development workflows including Git version control, code reviews, and team collaboration in an Agile-style environment

contact.heading: Let's build something together
contact.description: I'm currently open to new opportunities as a Frontend Developer. Whether you have a question or just want to say hi, my inbox is always open.
